abilities.critical_success: The triggering creature steps back from the edge before it collapses.
abilities.effect: The edge of the pit crumbles. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 19 Reflex save.
abilities.failure: The triggering creature falls prone and slides into the pit, taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
abilities.name: Crumbling Edge
abilities.trigger: A creature comes within 5 feet of the pit's edge

hazard.description: This open pit was once covered with branches— it's now visible, but its unstable edges are not obvious.
hazard.name: Unstable Pit

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
